title: Australia 482 Visa 2026: Skills in Demand Guide
metaDescription: Australia 482 visa 2026: Core Skills $79,423, Specialist $146,576, 1 year experience, IELTS 5.0. Full Skills in Demand requirements. Apply today.
headline: Australia's Skills in Demand 482 Visa in 2026

sections.title: What is the 482 visa?
sections.content:
The Skills in Demand visa, subclass 482, lets an approved Australian employer sponsor a skilled worker from overseas for up to four years. It replaced the Temporary Skill Shortage (TSS) visa on 7 December 2024. The visa is tied to a specific employer and a specific occupation, and three approvals must align: the business must be approved as a sponsor, the position must be approved through a nomination, and the worker must then be granted the visa.

There are three streams: Core Skills, Specialist Skills and Labour Agreement. The announced Essential Skills stream is not yet in force. There is no age limit for the 482 visa, which makes it one of the more accessible employer-sponsored routes into Australia.

sections.title: Salary thresholds for 2026
sections.content:
For nominations lodged on or after 1 July 2026, the Core Skills Income Threshold is AUD 79,423 and the Specialist Skills Income Threshold is AUD 146,576. Thresholds are indexed every 1 July, so the figures that apply are those in force on the date the nomination is lodged, not the date it is decided.

The worker must also be paid at least the annual market salary rate, meaning no less than an Australian worker doing equivalent work in the same workplace. Meeting the threshold alone is not enough where the market rate is higher. The Specialist Skills stream has no occupation list, but the role must fall within ANZSCO major groups 1, 2, 4, 5 or 6.

sections.title: Applicant requirements
sections.content:
Applicants need at least one year of relevant work experience in the nominated occupation or a closely related field, within the last five years. This was reduced from two years when the Skills in Demand framework began. The nominated occupation must be on the Core Skills Occupation List, which covers 456 occupations, for the Core Skills stream.

English language proficiency is required, usually IELTS 5.0 in each component or an equivalent score in another accepted test, unless an exemption applies. A skills assessment is only required for the occupations and passports listed in the legislative instrument IMMI 18/039. Health insurance and clean health and character checks are also required.

sections.title: Processing times and pathway to PR
sections.content:
Processing times vary by stream. Around half of Specialist Skills applications are decided within 37 days and 90% within 78 days, while Core Skills applications take about four months for half and nine months for 90%. The visa charge last rose on 1 July 2026.

The 482 visa offers a clearer pathway to permanent residence through the Subclass 186 Employer Nomination Scheme after two years with the sponsoring employer. Family members can be included in the application, and partners generally receive work rights. The Labour Agreement stream covers employers with a negotiated agreement whose terms can depart from the standard settings.

faqs.q: What is the minimum salary for a 482 visa in 2026?
faqs.a: For nominations lodged from 1 July 2026, the Core Skills Income Threshold is AUD 79,423 and the Specialist Skills Income Threshold is AUD 146,576. The salary must also meet the annual market salary rate for the role, whichever figure is higher. Thresholds are indexed every 1 July.

faqs.q: How much work experience do you need for a 482 visa?
faqs.a: You need at least one year of relevant work experience in the nominated occupation or a closely related field, within the last five years. This was reduced from two years when the Skills in Demand framework replaced the Temporary Skill Shortage visa on 7 December 2024.

faqs.q: What English score is needed for the 482 visa?
faqs.a: You usually need IELTS 5.0 in each component, or an equivalent score in another accepted test, unless an exemption applies. Test results must generally be no more than three years old. Limited passport exemptions apply for citizens of certain English-speaking countries.

faqs.q: Can a 482 visa lead to permanent residence?
faqs.a: Yes. The 482 visa offers a pathway to permanent residence through the Subclass 186 Employer Nomination Scheme after two years with the sponsoring employer. Family members can be included in the application, and the visa itself allows stays of up to four years.
